mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friendship (user_id, friend_id, status, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friendship WHERE (user_id = #{a} AND friend_id = #{b}) OR (user_id = #{b} AND friend_id = #{a}) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE friendship SET status = 'ACCEPTED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS "id", f.remark AS "remark", f.created_at AS "createdAt", u.id AS "friendUserId", u.username AS "username", u.real_name AS "realName", u.phone AS "phone", u.status AS "status" FROM friendship f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END WHERE (f.user_id = #{userId} OR f.friend_id = #{userId}) AND f.status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC

SELECT f.id AS "id", f.remark AS "remark", f.created_at AS "createdAt", u.id AS "fromUserId", u.username AS "username", u.real_name AS "realName" FROM friendship f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT f.id AS "id", f.created_at AS "createdAt", u.id AS "toUserId", u.username AS "username", u.real_name AS "realName" FROM friendship f JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invite_rebate (inviter_id, invitee_id, recharge_order_id, recharge_amount, rate_percent, amount) VALUES (#{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{rechargeOrderId}, #{rechargeAmount}, #{ratePercent}, #{amount}) ON CONFLICT (recharge_order_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS "id", r.recharge_amount AS "rechargeAmount", r.rate_percent AS "ratePercent", r.amount AS "amount", r.created_at AS "createdAt", u.real_name AS "inviteeName", u.username AS "inviteeUsername", o.order_no AS "orderNo" FROM invite_rebate r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.invitee_id JOIN recharge_order o ON o.id = r.recharge_order_id WHERE r.inviter_id = #{inviterId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM invite_rebate WHERE inviter_id = #{inviterId}
SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) FROM invite_rebate WHERE inviter_id = #{inviterId}
